hypothesis: At least one of two independent attractor-breaking interventions breaks C's bump attractor on canonical pomaze. (a) ANTI-HABITUATION: an additive per-channel penalty proportional to recent wins in the competed bid breaks the self-reinforcing loop directly (targets the habituation-freeze half). (b) GAIN-FLOOR LIFT: raising the gain floor from 0.01 to 0.5 lets the predictor's stimulus variation reach selection (targets the integration-failure half).
null: C stays stuck: neither intervention reduces stuck-fraction by >=0.3 with return improving by >=1.0 (the attractor is not the mechanism, or is not breakable this way).

verdict_mapping.ATTRACTOR_BROKEN_USABLE: >=1 intervention fires G1 and passes G2 -> 0010 mechanism confirmed causally; the intervention is a candidate repair of the C integration failure
verdict_mapping.BROKEN_BUT_DESTRUCTIVE: G1 fires but G2 fails -> the loop IS the mechanism (causal confirmation), but this intervention is not a usable repair (trades the attractor for destroyed healthy performance)
verdict_mapping.NULL_HOLDS: no intervention fires G1 -> record as negative result (research/negative_results.md); the attractor is not breakable this way, or the 0010 mechanism is wrong
